_experiment: E8 - does the judge decide before it reasons?
_variable: LATTICE_JUDGE_FORMAT. decision_first is the contract every run before 2026-09-19 used: each `checked` entry opens with the verdict token and justifies it afterwards. reason_first states the observation and ends with the token. The reason_first variant also corrects the prompt's worked example, whose first entry labels a satisfied condition 'no' while its prose says 'so that one is satisfied' -- so the two changes are tested together, not separately.
_measure: Rejections of check-passing candidates: candidates whose deterministic check was already full and which the judge returned not_met on. 21-31% in the decision_first condition (15/54, 17/55, 9/42, 50-findings/13). Earned score over the 28 non-floor tasks is the downstream consequence, reported beside it.
_order: Grouped by arm, then model, then format, so a queue that stops early still yields complete 2x2 cells rather than half of each.
_reused: baseline and monolith are NOT in this queue. Neither has a judge stage, so neither can move with this variable. Read them from M6-evaluation-suite/results/ (qwen) and M6-evaluation-suite/results_nemotron_nothink/ (nemotron) for the floor and the no-judge reference.
_nemotron_reasoning: off in both format arms, holding it comparable to qwen, which has no reasoning channel. On the same audit prompt both emit a ```json fence then the object -- 8 characters before the verdict. Neither model deliberates in either condition; that is a separate question from this one.

Effect size is the point: the decision_first rejection rate of 21-31% was measured at N=1 on Nemotron and N=3-5 on qwen, and a difference between formats cannot be sized against a single draw. Cells already recorded at this exact setup are seeded by seed_from_existing.py and topped up by --resume rather than re-run: qwen judge_anchored is already N=5 and costs nothing, qwen judge_bypass and judge_caveat are N=3 and need 2 more, the three nemotron decision_first cells are N=1 and need 4 more, and all six reason_first cells run from zero.
